description: Type D — pages publiques sans auth + pages privées avec auth, routing par slug @unique. Cas représentatif : writer-pad (Article slug+published → Category slug, Resource → Article).
models: Article { id String @id @default(uuid()), title String, content String, excerpt String?, slug String @unique, published Boolean @default(false), categoryId String, category Category @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade), userId String, resources Resource[], createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt }
Category { id String @id @default(uuid()), name String, slug String @unique, userId String, articles Article[], createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt }

Resource { id String @id @default(uuid()), title String, url String, description String?, articleId String, article Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade), userId String, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt }
